label: dam-probe-p4
_why: ENGINE PROBE of the hydro-dam megaprojects (ROADMAP step 6, BALANCE_FRAMEWORK §10.90, user-ruled 2026-09-26: 'Go on with the tests. Full 100 years n=1 after all the probes you need'). ARM = config/mod_config.canon-dams-probe.json {kind: config}: the canon (canon-b164-trade) + building_required_construction {building_power_plant: 1600} + dams {enabled, the FINAL 159-project table with researched anchor provinces} + dams.probe {the three class technologies granted at the start to GBR FRA USA RUS PRU AUS SWE SAR SWI TUR; surveys 2 months; stage cost x0.05}. The probe settings exist ONLY to make the mechanism fire inside three years; nothing economic is read from this run. P4 over p3 (20260926_152100): p3 showed the yearly driver building stages (80 starts, 22 built) but the AI still took several survey decisions the same day. P4: the AI no longer takes the decision (ai_chance 0); a QUARTERLY driver per AI country starts at most one survey (surveys under way < 1-3 by GDP) and at most one stage (stages under construction < 1-6 by GDP), burden checks, subjects stricter; stages of one project may build in parallel.

_questions.Q1: Surveys: at most one new per country per quarter, none cancelled?
_questions.Q2: Construction: stage_start and built lines, concurrency within the GDP slots, parallel stages?

_cost: 1 run x 1836.1.1 -> 1841.1.1, about 7 minutes of play plus build and load.
_caveats: Launch ONLY through tools/testbed/launch_detached.ps1 CALLED DIRECTLY from the PowerShell tool (landmine L30).
Probe build: techs granted, costs and surveys shrunk - do not read any economic number from it.
